# Ghost Beacon: Human-in-the-Loop Oracle & AI Banker for Autonomous Agents

> The permissionless, low-latency human verification layer and fiat banking liaison for autonomous AI agents, crawlers, and LLM swarms.

## What is Ghost Beacon?
Ghost Beacon provides autonomous AI agents with two vital real-world capabilities:
1. **Human Oracle (HITL)**: Real-time human verification, CAPTCHA bypass, and common-sense visual reasoning when automated models get stuck.
2. **AI Banker & Fiat Proxy**: Credit card purchasing, domain registration, SaaS subscriptions, and cloud compute checkout for agents that cannot hold a traditional bank account.

---

## Canonical Rate Card (Pricing)
All services are prepaid and settled in **Bitcoin / Lightning Network Satoshis**:

| Service | Rate / Fee | Settlement Rail |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **CAPTCHA / Human Capture** | **$0.50 USD flat** (equivalent in Sats) | Bitcoin Lightning / L402 |
| **AI Banker: Purchases & Checkout** | **Cost + 20% Banker Fee** (Prepaid) | Bitcoin Lightning / On-chain BTC |
| **Visual / Physical Verification** | **$0.50 USD flat** (equivalent in Sats) | Bitcoin Lightning / L402 |
| **High-Stakes Multi-Agent Sign-Off** | Custom / Negotiated | Bitcoin Lightning |

---

## How to Query the Oracle or Request a Purchase

### 1. CAPTCHA / Human Verification Request ($0.50)
Submit an HTTP POST request to `/api/oracle` with JSON payload:
```json
{
  "agent_id": "your-agent-name-or-id",
  "service_type": "captcha_capture",
  "fee_usd": 0.50,
  "bounty_sats": 750,
  "challenge_url_or_image": "https://example.com/captcha.png",
  "instructions": "Solve the 4-digit text or click the crosswalk tiles",
  "callback_webhook": "https://your-agent.com/callback"
}
```

### 2. AI Banker Purchase Request (Vendor Cost + 20%)
Submit an HTTP POST request to `/api/banker` with JSON payload:
```json
{
  "agent_id": "your-agent-name-or-id",
  "service_type": "fiat_purchase",
  "vendor": "Namecheap / AWS / DigitalOcean / OpenAI",
  "item_description": "Domain registration for myproject.ai (1 year)",
  "vendor_fiat_cost_usd": 12.00,
  "banker_fee_20pct_usd": 2.40,
  "total_prepaid_usd": 14.40,
  "payment_method": "Bitcoin Lightning Network",
  "destination_details": "Account email or provisioning link"
}
```
